findings.passage: Today I vetoed SB1069. As I stated last year when I vetoed an identical bill, ensuring the safety of all Arizonans is a priority for my administration. Gun silencers make it more difficult for hard-working law enforcement officers to do their job and keep Arizonans safe.

findings.passage: Today I vetoed SB1053.
